_noteP: Soul Siphon (MorganaPassive) only carries a 'HealPercent' DataValue and zero mSpellCalculations -- Morgana heals for a % of the damage her spells deal to champions; it is not itself a new damage source. P carries no hits.
_noteQ: Dark Binding: TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(Damage) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat field -> AP default per FormulaInterpreter's 'part.Stat ?? 0', coefficient 0.9) -- Damage DataValues rank1-5 = 80/135/190/245/300, i.e. 80/135/190/245/300 (+90% AP), matching Dark Binding's known root-and-nuke formula.
_noteW: Tormented Shadow: a DoT that ticks every 0.5s (TickRate). TotalMinDamage (the guaranteed, unamplified per-tick baseline) = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat -> AP default, BaseApRatio=0.2) -- BaseDamage DataValues rank1-5 = 18/31/44/57/70, i.e. 18/31/44/57/70 (+20% AP) per tick. TotalMaxDamage = GameCalculationModified(TotalMinDamage) x (1 + MissingHealthAmpPercent=1.0), i.e. up to DOUBLE damage against a target at 0% current health -- a live target-missing-health-scaled multiplier on TOP of another calc's result, which this schema has no field to express (HpBasis only scales a %HP hit's own fraction, not amplifies an unrelated flat calc), so per P2 the conservative unamplified baseline (TotalMinDamage) is curated and the missing-health ramp is left undocumented as a real but unmodeled bonus. Curated as ONE tick (count 1), matching Brand P/Skarner P's established DoT precedent.
_noteR: Soul Shackles: TotalDamage = NamedDataValue(Damage) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat -> AP default, coefficient 0.8) -- Damage DataValues rank1-3 = 200/275/350 (R has only 3 ranks), i.e. 200/275/350 (+80% AP), matching Soul Shackles' known chain-stun burst. This is the initial tether-snap burst to the primary target; the ability's own re-detonation on stun-break is the SAME calc reapplied, not a distinct one, and is not separately modeled (count 1, single application).
_noteW: W SLIDER (loop 479, user asked for a range slider on Tormented Shadow). The zone lasts 5s and ticks every 0.5s, and its total scales with the target MISSING HEALTH - live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Morgana, fetched 2026-08-21): minimum 90/155/220/285/350 (+100% AP) at full health, maximum 180/310/440/570/700 (+200% AP) against a nearly dead target. Both ends already existed in the BIN as TotalMinDamage and TotalMaxDamage; only the min was curated, so the ceiling was invisible. Migrated to the distance/charge-scaled shape, whose knob is a 0-1 slider between the two ends. calc stays TotalMinDamage, so the RESOLVED number does not move - this only adds the opposite end and the range that spans it, exactly the zero-regression migration SkillHit.MaxCalc documents. Zone tag kept: full duration is still assumed and the target can walk out.
